splitTotalMismatch: The split total must equal the invoice total.
paymentComponentRequired: Enter at least one payment amount.
creditCustomerRequired: Select an active customer before using credit.
creditDisabled: Credit is not enabled for this customer.
creditTenantPolicyDisabled: Customer credit has not been enabled in tenant settings.
creditOnHold: This customer account is on credit hold.
creditOwnerApprovalRequired: Owner approval is required for customer credit.
creditLimitExceeded: This sale exceeds the available customer credit.
creditOverdueBlocked: Overdue customer credit must be resolved before this sale.
creditInitialInvalid: Enter a valid initial payment from 0 up to the invoice total.
creditExplicitZero: Enter 0 for a fully unpaid sale.
creditFullPaymentUseTender: Use Cash, Card, or Split for a fully paid sale.
